Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically focuses on the RARα interactome using SILAC to compare vehicle vs ATRA treatment in RARα-overexpressing (RA-453) vs control (FL-453) cells. Other genetic perturbations (S100A3 knockdown/overexpression) are discussed as functional validation but the primary MS dataset (PXD008761) is tied to the ATRA/RARα axis.
